title: Squaring requires an assumption
hook: Two stated cases: explore the conditional probability needed for a joint rare event.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the conditional probability needed for a joint rare event affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Joint, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the conditional probability needed for a joint rare event in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
